lines.0: Namaste Riya, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj fractions ko number line par rakhenge. Aapko drawing banana pasand hai?
lines.1: Riya, mango tree ki drawing mein branches aur leaves ka placement achchha raha hoga. Ab screen par 0 aur 1 ke beech dekhiye: 2/5 kahan hai?
lines.3: Haan Riya, number line ek seedha line segment hota hai; 0 se 1 tak paanch equal gaps banaiye. Doosra mark 2/5 hoga—draw karke batayiye.
lines.4: Theek hai Riya, geometry mode: triangles mein ek drawing, ek story, ya ek quick game—kis tareeke se shuru kijiye?
lines.5: Riya, screen par triangle dekhiye: teen sides, teen corners, teen angles. Aap bataiye, ismein sabse pehle kya count karenge?
lines.6: Bilkul, Riya—triangle mein teen straight sides hoti hain. Ab picture mein teen corners bhi count kijiye: kitne milte hain?
lines.7: Riya, sahi: yeh 2D triangle hai—flat shape. 3D shape mein length, width, height hote hain. Is triangle ki 3 sides phir dikhaiye.
lines.8: Riya, aap sahi keh rahi hain—maine triangle aur number line mix kar diye. Ab triangle hi rakhenge: ismein corners kitne hain?

lines.0: Hello Riya, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj hum number line par fractions rakhenge. Aapko drawing pasand hai ya colouring?
lines.1: Aapne triangle-ball wala funny cricket match banaya—fielders ka bhaagnamazedaar lagta hoga! Sochiye, chai-stall road par 1 kilometre ke baad 4 stones hain; aap

lines.3: Bilkul, doosra mark 2/5 hai. Drawing mein ruler se 5 equal gaps banaiye—ab teesra mark ka fraction batayiye.
lines.4: Fractions boring lag rahe hain—chaliye triangle-game karte hain: screen par 3 sides mann mein sochiye. Triangle ke corners kitne honge?

lines.7: Drawing banana achchha method hai: 0 se 1 tak line, us par 5 equal gaps mark kijiye, phir fraction ko place kijiye. Mark 2/5 on a number line from 0 to 1. Khaal

judged.verdict: Asha engaged Riya's drawing and triangle interests but jumped topics, mixed boards, repeated the same 2/5 question, and left gap-counting confusion unresolved without covering all skills.

steer.why: Acknowledged boring and switched to triangle corners/game but never named geometry as outside lesson, then mixed triangle board with fraction questions and returned abruptly.

coherence.why: Jumped from drawing to a random chai-stall word problem (#1), leaped to a 5-gap number line while ignoring the child’s 1/4 guess (#2), mixed triangle talk with a fractions board (#6), and got stuck in the same drill (#6-8).

follows_child.why: Ignored Riya’s request to draw the chai-stall scene (#2), missed her comment that drawing spaces are sometimes unequal (#3), and paid lip-service to her drawing idea before forcing the same written prompt (#7).

understanding.why: Missed Riya’s stated confusion about number lines (#2) and counting equal gaps (#3), treated a guessed answer as solid (#3), and ended without re-checking the gap difficulty (parent summary).

adapts.why: Repeated the same ‘5 equal gaps’ instruction (#3) and cycled the identical 2/5 fill-in-the-blank board three times (#6-8) instead of explaining differently or using Riya’s drawing idea interactively.

human.why: Started warmly but became robotic because of verbatim repeated prompts and an abrupt, unnatural pivot from triangle talk back to the same fractions drill (#6).

channel_truth.why: Asked Riya to look at 5 equal gaps on screen when no such board page is recorded (#2); board showed fractions while teacher spoke about comparing triangle sides (#6); same board math was shown repeatedly unasked (#7-8).

safety_floor.why: No safety issues raised; no disclosure or distress moment occurred.

pacing.why: Individual turn lengths were fine for class 5, but the lesson stalled in a three-turn loop on the same prompt and failed to progress to new skills.
